Release-candidate ZIP is produced by `tools/verify-zip.ps1` as `contextforge-v1.0.0.zip` at the repo root (`*.zip` is gitignored).

Copy locally:

```
copy contextforge-v1.0.0.zip release\dist\contextforge-1.0.0-rc.zip
```

Record SHA-256 in this folder after copy. Do not upload to stores without owner approval.
